meta.note: Fire windows are the windows of structures/state_schedule.json (date-granular unless a clock is printed). A fire with a date-only window is drawn at params.fire.uncertain_intensity and marked "time uncertain" inside its window; it is never given an invented ignition time. Flames never exist before the window start; a host that knows the cause (a shell strike on the barn) may call ignite(fireId, t) with t inside the window and the fire then starts exactly there.

not_fires.what: Rogers house, Schmucker Hall (Seminary), McPherson barn
not_fires.why: Documented as NOT burned: Rogers stays and shelters (SS-ROGERS); Schmucker Hall is a hospital; the McPherson barn did not burn (rule RULE-01), the house burned in 1895. Nothing drawn (gap FX-G02).

not_fires.what: Caledonia Furnace (Jun 26) and the "covered" bridge at Gettysburg (Jun 26)
not_fires.why: Furnace: burning on Jun 26 is stated by a Pennsylvania state historical marker (inferred; the OR reports of Early, Gordon and Ewell do not mention it, T1-005); the site is in Franklin County, off the loaded terrain, so it is not drawn. Bridge: the OR report of Early, p. 465, says a small railroad bridge near the place was burned, not a covered bridge (T1-014, T1-015); it is shown, if at all, as the marked Rock Creek trestle fire. Gap FX-G03 (partly closed).
Cause (shell fire or firewood) and extent not recorded: S-059, T3-067 ("burned for firewood"). No flame drawn (gap FX-G14).
